newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight bank rates remain high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight bank rates remain high.

text.p: Pakistan interbank overnight rates remained high on Tuesday despite maturity of an open market operation (OMO), dealers said.
"The OMO maturity could not dent the sky-high interest rates significantly and overnight trading was mostly conducted at the 20 percent mark," one dealer of KASB & Co said.
Bids were quoted at around 18.5 and 19 percent early in the day but it was the lenders who prevailed later, he said.
